title: Round 78 (F384): Cell flag analysis - flag0 values {0,1,2,3,252-255}, high flags (252-255) = single sentinel cells per map (317 maps), client blocking = type 0x32 minimap markers (0x4123E3) NOT cell flags, attr byte = tile-row selector (F331)
objective: Analyze the map cell flag byte: value distribution, high-flag semantics, and the client's actual blocking mechanism.
question: What do cell flag bytes mean, and how does the client block movement?
method: map-audit cell_flag0 distribution; per-map high-flag check; client blocking cross-ref (0x4123E3 type 0x32).

cell_analysis.high_flags: 252-255 = single sentinel cells in 317 maps (count 1 per map per value) - edge/anim markers, not mass blocking
cell_analysis.flag_semantics: flag byte = cell attribute (F331: attr/7 = tile-row selector for 14-byte cell rows; high values 252-255 = special markers)
cell_analysis.client_blocking: movement blocked by type 0x32 minimap markers: 0x4123E3 gate [0x7E335C]+0x88==0x32 -> return 1 (block); pick/select excludes 0x32 (0x41ECAE only 0/1, minimap pick 0x43CD0F only 0/1/3)
cell_analysis.NOT_cell_flag: cell flag bytes do NOT gate movement - blocking is entity-type-driven

audit_vs_exe.F254/map-ui: type 0x32 = blocking minimap marker (0x560070 list, 0x407F20) confirmed

contrast.cell_flag_vs_entity: cell flag = tile metadata; movement block = type 0x32 entity markers
contrast.sentinel_vs_block: 252-255 single cells = sentinels (1 per map); blocking = entity list

verdict: Cell flag analysis complete (primary-bytes): flag values {0,1,2,3,252-255} where high values = single sentinel cells (317 maps); the client blocks movement via type 0x32 minimap markers (0x4123E3), NOT cell flags. Cell flag = tile-row attr (F331).
evidence_level_note: Flag distribution from map binaries (audit); blocking gate read from MIR3.EXE.
reproduce: python3 -c map-audit cell_flag0 aggregation; verify 0x4123E3 gate
notes: flag 252/254/255 appear in 0.map as 1 cell each - corner sentinels
